candidate_route.fresh_generation_requirement: Generate fixed candidate programs locally from the selected canonical P0 only, after separately freezing the exact model, weights, runtime, prompts, sampling seeds, output schema, repair policy, and resource caps.
candidate_route.reason: Released final/checkpoint programs may encode post-P0 observations and would weaken a prospective outcome interpretation.

claim_target: Prospective, investigator-blinded discovery of a separator among fresh P0-only executable hypotheses; any later real-outcome claim requires its own pre-outcome freeze and authorization.
future_phase_order: execute this frozen header-only source selection
commit and merge the selected game name and selection proof
extract only the selected level-1 P0 triplets and require equality across all five runs
freeze the canonical P0 and local candidate-generation package before model inference
generate and structurally admit fresh P0-only candidates without exposing behavior
freeze the mechanical adapter and exact opaque OIA input before running OIA
record OIA's selected separator before any held-out outcome is revealed or executed
prohibited_before_selection_is_merged: read or extract any archive member payload
read P0 bytes, candidate code, traces, reasoning logs, metadata content, or scores
execute a candidate, OIA, model, ARC action, hosted service, or credentialed operation

selection_rule.eligible_game: A lowercase four-character game root present in all five frozen runs, with regular-file initial_frame.png, initial_frame.txt, and initial_metadata.json members at level_01_attempt_01 in every run.
selection_rule.ranking: For each eligible game g, compute SHA-256 of UTF-8 AUDIT_ID, NUL, archive_sha256, NUL, g; choose the lexicographically smallest (digest, game) pair.
